title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.
   

  

 We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.
   

  

****Learn more****
* Candidate Safety \& Interview Process Notice
* Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
* How We Use Candidate Data
* Equal Employment Opportunity
* Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

Since the dawn of the internet, we’ve helped brands move first through every era of transformation, defining what digital means for business and now leading brands into the age of AI. Everyone has a prediction. Razorfish has a track record.
   

  

 Named a Most Innovative Agency three years running (2024–2026\) by Campaign US, our work reflects a proven ability not just to anticipate what’s coming, but to help our clients actively shape the future. No matter the trend or cultural moment, delivering real business impact wouldn’t be possible without our people. We bring together curious, driven, and diverse thinkers who challenge convention, push boundaries, and hold a high bar for creative excellence.
   

  

 If you’re motivated to work alongside top performers, push the boundaries of what’s possible, and help define where technology, business, and marketing are headed next—this is the place to do it.

 We are seeking a Creative Director to lead integrated creative initiatives for a large, high\-profile energy client, with an emphasis on brand advocacy and campaign development. The ideal candidate is a strong conceptual thinker and collaborative leader who remains close to the work, can translate business objectives into compelling creative ideas, and can confidently guide teams from brief through execution.

title: Creative Director, Partnerships & Collectibles
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
   

  

**Overview**
 Crocs is seeking a
 **Creative Director, Partnerships and Collectibles** 
 to lead the creative vision and execution behind brand collaborations, limited\-edition drops, and collectible storytelling that connect with culture in unexpected ways. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Creative, this role will define how Crocs shows up alongside brands, talent, and cultural voices, creating ideas that balance multiple perspectives while ensuring every partnership feels authentic, additive, and unmistakably Crocs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a visionary leader and systems thinker who can build creative concepts that extend across product, packaging, campaign storytelling, e\-commerce, visual merchandising, and experience. They are deeply inspired by culture, design, and craft, with a passion for bringing different worlds together through innovative storytelling and collectible experiences. Comfortable navigating complexity across teams, partners, and priorities, this leader maintains clarity of vision while delivering thoughtful, culturally relevant work that reflects Crocs' Wonderfully Unordinary spirit.This role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for the full creative expression of partnerships, from campaign development across film and photography to packaging, product storytelling, e\-commerce, and retail experiences.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Lead with vision: Define the creative direction for partnerships and collectibles, ensuring every collaboration feels balanced, intentional, and brand\-right
* Build ideas in partnership: Develop concepts that bring two brands together in harmony, creating something new without compromising either identity
* Own the full expression: Oversee creative across campaigns, film, photography, packaging, e\-commerce, and retail environments
* Champion storytelling: Translate partnership strategy into compelling narratives that drive cultural relevance and consumer excitement
* Design for product and drop culture: Shape how collaborations come to life through packaging, collectibles, and in\-hand experiences
* Lead and inspire teams: Guide a multidisciplinary team across art direction, design, and copy, setting a high bar for both thinking and execution
* Collaborate cross\-functionally: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Merchandising, and external collaborators to align creative with business and cultural opportunity
* Drive craft and consistency: Ensure all outputs reflect a high level of quality, cohesion, and attention to detail across every touchpoint
* Navigate complexity: Manage multiple partners, timelines, and expectations while maintaining creative clarity and momentum
* Present with impact: Communicate ideas and creative direction confidently to internal leadership and external partners
* Stay culturally attuned: Bring awareness of trends, collaborators, and cultural movements to identify meaningful partnership opportunities
* Experiment with new tools: Stay curious and open to innovation — exploring how AI, emerging technology, and evolving creative processes can unlock new ways to tell stories and create at scale


****What You'll Bring to the Table****
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience
* At least 10\+ years of experience in creative roles across brand, agency, or in\-house teams
* At least 3\+ years leading and developing creative teams
* Strong experience in brand collaborations, partnerships, or cultural marketing
* Proven ability to lead work across campaigns, packaging, retail, and digital touchpoints
* Expert\-level art direction, design, and or copywriting skills
* Strong storytelling and concept development abilities
* Experience working with external partners, collaborators, and talent
* Ability to manage complex projects with multiple collaborators
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to craft across all outputs
* Understanding of consumer insights, trends, and cultural dynamics


 The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other classification protected by law.

 Pay offered will vary based on job\-related factors such as location, experience, training, skills, and abilities.
   

  

 At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in\-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In\-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2\-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). title: Creative Director, Wellness
description:
Our
 **Beauty \& Wellness** 
 division empowers consumers with trusted products that support self\-care, from salon\-quality styling tools to wellness devices like humidifiers and air purifiers. Our innovative products and solutions promote healthy living, elevating the lives of consumers every day. This business unit includes Braun, PUR, Honeywell, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, and Revlon brands, and this role may support one or more of these brands.
   

  

**Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere,** 
 in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward\-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!
   

  

**Position:** 
 Creative Director, Wellness
   

  

**Department:** 
 Braun, Honeywell, PUR, \& Vicks
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Marlborough, MA Hybrid (work 3 days onsite)
   

  

**Hybrid Schedule:** 
 At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in\-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 The Creative Director drives the creative vision, execution, and design team for the Wellness brand portfolio (Braun, Honeywell, PUR, \& Vicks). This position requires a leader who can develop differentiated, strategic, and compelling creative solutions that deliver on\-brand business goals across all consumer touch points.
   

  

 This leader is responsible for shaping and executing cohesive, elevated brand experiences across packaging design, package design for new product launches, point\-of\-sale collateral, digital executions, and design for special events, including video, photography, web, and social.
   

  

 As a hands\-on Creative Director and experienced people leader, this role will guide a multidisciplinary design team of 6\+ people while partnering cross\-functionally with Marketing, Innovation, and Engineering to bring breakthrough ideas to market. The Creative Director will bring a mix of artistic, marketing, and business expertise to the position to support our mission to drive growth and develop strong brand equities.
   

  

* Develops and provides creative direction for all brand and marketing expressions across packaging, digital, eCommerce, social, and video content.
* Oversees creation and design of visual identity systems and brand guidelines.
* Provides visionary oversight and creative direction for our brands and ensures effective creative development and executional brilliance.
* Partners with Marketing teams to ensure a planned, collaborative, and cohesive design approach across all consumer touch points.
* Works closely with the brand teams to translate creative brief into compelling consumer touch points.
* Generates new ideas and innovations for: creative execution, customer experience, work process and execution.
* Integrates generative AI into the design process to accelerate concept exploration, prototyping, and execution while elevating craft and originality.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to execute creative strategies.
* Drives creative brainstorms with cross\-functional teams to help surface new, innovative packaging and digital assets.
* Stays current with the competitive landscape, emerging trends, and consumer behavior. Understand marketing initiatives, strategic positioning, and target audience across brands.
* Maintains awareness of current trends in design and merchandising (both in\-store and online) and completes audits to observe competitive landscape and research trends and materials.
* Build relationships and manages outside agencies to ensure work supports brand standards and achieves goals.
* Collaborates closely with New Product Development (NPD) Engineers and Marketing to provide directions on all internal design work.
* Improves processes and practices working with Creative Studio Services and their team to increase quality and accuracy.
* Creates a vision to be shared with the creative team as well as marketing teams.


**Leadership of the Creative Team / Department**
* Ensures the creative team structure aligns with evolving business needs, priorities, and growth objectives.
* Provides leadership, guidance, and support to the creative team while establishing best practices for artwork file management, server organization, and asset governance.
* Builds team capabilities across design, storytelling, and emerging digital formats through training and development initiatives; manages Graphic Designers, Senior Designers, the Associate Creative Director, Digital Asset Associate, and freelance resources.
* Creates clear career paths and provides ongoing coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for direct reports.
* Fosters team engagement and growth through collaboration, mentorship, and creative talent development.
* Leads by example as a hands\-on creative leader, contributing strategic thinking and creative expertise when needed.
* Cultivates a culture of creativity, excellence, accountability, and results\-driven performance.
* Empowers team members to confidently execute, make decisions, and lead within their respective roles and areas of expertise.
* Manages the creative budget, identifying cost\-saving opportunities and operational efficiencies that support business growth and improve margins.


**Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role**
* Seasoned Design skills.
* Color and print management skills, and knowledge of design trends in the marketplace.
* Strong project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Leadership skills with examples of programs or processes that have exemplified those skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, teamwork, and time management skills.
* Incorporates feedback and takes directions well.
* Team player with strong presentation skills.
* Strong leadership experience and interpersonal skills to inspire, manage, and grow high\-performing.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* BFA in Graphic Design or equivalent experience.
* 15 \+ years of experience in Graphic Design and Package Design.
* Expert knowledge of graphic software programs such as Adobe Creative Suite and expert knowledge of best package design practices and integrated digital content.
* Extensive experience managing and leading teams of creative professionals across disciplines.
* Authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.


 In Massachusetts, the standard base pay range for this role is $130,393 \- $162,992 annually. This base pay range is specific to Massachusetts and may not be applicable to other locations. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.
   

  

**Benefits:**

title: Studio Director
description:
Westside Design, in partnership with Westside Build, is a Santa Monica\-based design and construction firm rebuilding homes across the Pacific Palisades in the wake of the wildfire. We bring architecture, design, and construction under one roof, with a strong emphasis on technology, speed, and craft.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Studio Director** 
 to lead an entire studio across client management, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can operate as a broad\-based leader rather than a narrow specialist, someone who can move between client conversations, project strategy, technical issues, team leadership, and day\-to\-day studio needs with ease.
   

  

 This role is intended to be more of a multi\-tool leadership position: a person who can talk about contracts, deal with clients, guide design, engage technical and CA issues, and help support the Managing Principal lead the full studio. The Studio Director will directly lead our Project Managers and Project Architects, who are responsible for BIM model development, construction documentation, and permit\-ready deliverables in Revit. You will set the design intent and quality bar that the team documents and executes against, review their work at key milestones, and serve as the design authority they escalate to on coordination, code, and client\-facing design decisions.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 13\+ years of professional experience in architecture, residential design\-build, or a comparable studio environment
* 8\+ years leading complex residential projects through design, technical coordination, and delivery
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role spanning client management, contracts, team oversight, and project execution
* Residential experience, especially custom homes, ADUs, and rebuild work
* Proven ability to lead across contracts, client management, design discussions, technical coordination, and CA
* Strong leadership presence and sound judgment in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience overseeing teams, projects, and multiple stakeholder relationships
* Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership
* Must bring direct experience in a comparable leadership seat; this is not intended as a step\-up role from PM or senior project architect


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years in a role such as Studio Director, Senior Project Manager, Design Director, or similar leadership role
* Experience in integrated architecture/construction or design\-build settings
* Familiarity with consultant coordination, construction documentation, and field\-related problem solving


**Studio Leadership**
* Lead the overall performance of the studio across client service, project execution, staffing coordination, and day\-to\-day operations
* Serve as a senior leader helping guide studio priorities, unblock issues, and maintain momentum across multiple active projects
* Partner with firm leadership on studio structure, resourcing, and operational effectiveness
* Help create accountability across the studio by following up on open items, pushing decisions forward, and keeping workstreams moving


**Client \& Project Leadership**
* Serve as a senior point of contact for clients and help manage relationships across active work

title: Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations
description:
The Senior Director of AI Transformation \& Operations serves as the operational heart of the ELEC AI Center of Excellence.
  

  

This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for translating our enterprise\-wide AI strategy into reality.
  

  

You will provide the structure, shared foundations, and governance that enable our four business lines to deliver AI solutions with speed, quality, and precision.
**Job Description**
===================


**The mission of the AI Operations Leader within our office is to:**


* **Enable Execution:** Facilitate the execution of Business Line long\-term strategy (LTS) plans, ensuring they move at speed and with high impact.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Define and manage the day\-to\-day mechanisms that deliver consistent quality, ensuring that every AI initiative is executed with discipline and minimal risk.
* **Scale Through Capability:** Act as the operational backbone of our center of excellence, transforming our strategy into repeatable processes that allow our businesses to own and scale their AI delivery effectively.

**What you’ll be doing**


* **Facilitating business execution:** You will act as the primary partner for our four business lines. Your focus is on clearing the path for them to execute their long\-term strategic AI plans, ensuring they have the support and resources needed to reach their goals quickly and effectively.
* **Defining the operational heartbeat:** You will establish the "cadence" of AI delivery—regular reviews, progress tracking, and feedback loops—that keep our business lines aligned and moving forward.
* **Providing a shared foundation:** You will lead the development of the "common ground"—the standards, tools, and shared platforms—that allow our business units to build AI solutions without having to solve the same infrastructure or governance problems in isolation.
* **Driving speed and quality:** You will help our business teams balance the need for rapid delivery with the need for high\-quality, reliable output. By implementing clear, lightweight ways of working, you will help teams avoid common pitfalls and keep projects on track.
* **Managing risk by design:** Instead of treating risk as a hurdle to be jumped at the end, you will help teams bake it into their processes from day one. You will ensure that Responsible AI and security practices are built into the workflow, protecting the business while maintaining momentum.
* **Ensuring strategic alignment:** You will oversee our portfolio to ensure that the work happening across the business lines stays tethered to ELEC’s overarching enterprise priorities. You will help teams focus their energy on the initiatives that provide the greatest return.
* **Supporting the transition:** We are working toward a future where our business lines are fully empowered to lead their own AI delivery. You will guide this evolution, scaling our efforts today to build a sustainable, business\-led model for 2030\.
* **Driving adoption and upskilling:** You will champion the human side of our transformation by leading efforts to upskill our workforce. In close coordination with ELEC HR, the GE Vernova Corporate Learning team, the ELEC CTO office, and Business Line AI teams, you will design and adapt training programs that directly address the unique missions and practical needs of our ELEC teams. By building targeted AI literacy and specialized expertise, you will ensure our people are empowered to adopt new tools and maximize the value of AI in their specific daily work.

**What you bring to the team**


* **A commitment to partnership:** You have a track record of supporting business units in achieving their strategic goals. You view your role as a service to the business lines, not as a central authority.
* **A "get it done" mindset:** You understand that the best strategy is only valuable if it can be executed. You are experienced in guiding complex initiatives through to delivery while maintaining high standards.
* **Balanced judgment:** You know how to provide enough guidance to ensure consistency across the company without creating unnecessary red tape that slows teams down.
* **Technical and business fluency:** You can communicate clearly with both technical delivery teams and business leadership, ensuring that everyone understands the goals and the path to achieving them.
* **Proven reliability:** You have a history of managing programs or operations where speed, quality, and risk management were all critical to success.

**How we’ll measure success**


* **LTS Execution:** Our business lines are successfully hitting the milestones set out in their long\-term AI strategy plans.
* **Operational Speed:** We have reduced the time it takes to get from an idea to a working, value\-driving solution.
* **Risk \& Quality:** Our AI initiatives consistently meet our internal standards for security and responsibility, with minimal friction.
* **Business Impact:** Every AI project we support can clearly demonstrate its contribution to ELEC’s business performance.

**Skills \& Academic Requirements**


To lead this transformation effectively, you will need a blend of technical understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to influence people.


* **Academic \& Professional Background:**
	+ **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
	+ **Experience:** Strong and proven leadership experience in operations, program management, or technical strategy, ideally within a large, global matrixed organization.
	+ **AI/Technical Fluency:** A solid grasp of the AI/ML landscape—not necessarily as a developer, but as a leader who understands the lifecycle of AI solutions, from data preparation to production and monitoring.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ **Strategic Change Management:** Proven success in leading large\-scale organizational shifts, including the ability to build and sustain engagement across diverse teams.
	+ **Operational Discipline:** Exceptional ability to build, manage, and refine the "cadence" of a business—tracking metrics, managing budgets, and maintaining project momentum.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated expertise in bridging the gap between technical teams (CTO/Engineering) and business stakeholders. You know how to translate technical requirements into business value and vice\-versa.
	+ **Learning \& Development Agility:** A strong track record of partnering with HR and Learning \& Development functions to design curriculum or enablement programs. You understand that "upskilling" is not just about classroom training, but about driving behavioral change.
	+ **Influencing \& Negotiation:** The ability to achieve alignment across different business lines without having direct line authority over every team member. You lead through persuasion, shared goals, and the value you provide.
	+ **Risk \& Governance Mindset:** A pragmatic approach to compliance and ethics. You can integrate guardrails into the development process so that they feel like an asset rather than an obstacle.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  


As a Principal Product Designer on the UX Platform team, you will be the most senior individual design voice across the breadth of the UX Platform: the products our engineers and customers rely on every day, and the Design System that ties them together. You will partner closely with our Design Director as a trusted right hand, owning the hardest and most ambiguous problems, setting the quality bar, and helping decisions move so design is never the bottleneck.



Two things sit at the center of this role: designing for AI\-native experiences, and rethinking how design itself gets done in AI\-first workflows. We are fully immersed in both, and this role has a real hand in shaping where they go. We want someone genuinely eager to learn, test, and experiment here, but with the judgment to tell where AI raises the quality of the work and where it just adds noise. The aim is to use AI where it genuinely makes the work better, not to adopt it for its own sake.



You are a pragmatic optimist: ambitious about where we could go, honest about the terrain in front of us. You can hold “this is hard and might not work” and “let’s do it anyway, here’s how” in the same breath. You lead through craft and influence rather than authority, you take a vague problem and give it shape, you bring strong opinions but invite better ones, and you raise risks early and honestly. You lift the people around you by example, and the whole team’s work gets sharper because you are on it.

  


**What you'll do**

  

* Own the most complex and ambiguous design problems across our platform scope, from framing through detailed craft, end to end and with no oversight required.
* Design for AI\-native experiences: shape interfaces that are non\-deterministic and adapt to each use, design for outputs we cannot fully predict, and set the design principles and heuristics that keep those experiences coherent.
* Evolve how we design in AI\-first, spec\-driven workflows: help define how our role shifts, act as a multiplier for the team, and build ways to evaluate that we are shipping higher quality software, not just more of it.
* Set the bar for documentation and traceability: clear specs, references, and rationale that the team, our partners, and our AI tools can build on.
* Act as a second senior point of design judgment and a subject matter expert on our product: deputize for the Design Director in Product and Engineering reviews, shape strategic direction, and hold the quality bar across the whole product, not only your own area.
* Strengthen the connection between product design and the Design System, and define systems and processes that others across the company can benefit from.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to align on direction and keep work moving at a healthy cadence.
* Mentor designers, lead by example, and raise the overall level of craft across the team.


**This role requires**

  

* Extensive product design experience, including senior or lead work on complex software products.
* A portfolio that shows depth of craft and systems thinking across both product design and design systems, and recognized mastery of craft: a track record of raising the collective quality bar and defining patterns, systems, or processes that others adopt.
* A track record of owning ambiguous problems independently and driving them to real outcomes, end to end and without oversight.
* Comfort designing for AI\-native, non\-deterministic experiences, and enthusiasm for evolving how design gets done in AI\-first workflows.
* A discerning approach to AI: eager to experiment, but with the judgment to tell where it adds real value, and a quality bar that does not bend for the sake of hype.
* Ability to act as a subject matter expert who shapes priorities, leads research where useful, and interprets analysis into design decisions.
* Proven ability to influence Product and Engineering partners without formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and a habit of documenting decisions, rationale, and references clearly so that people and tools can build on them.


**Bonus points if you have**


* Experience designing services and platforms, especially in observability, developer tools, data, or complex B2B products.
* A technical background: an understanding of modern software architecture, and experience with data visualization.
* Experience contributing to or stewarding a design system at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or AI\-assisted design workflows.
* Comfort working in a distributed, cross\-cultural team.

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. * Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up\-to\-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

title: People Partner - Europe
description:
**Company Description**  

At EVERSANA®, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 670 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

  

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description** **THE POSITION****:**

The People Partner – Europe reports to the Senior People Director – Europe and works closely with both European and global HR teams, as well as cross\-functional partners such as Finance, Payroll, and Legal. To be considered for this role, candidates must be based in Ireland or Spain (home office), and have solid HR track record in more than 1 country in Europe:

**EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:**

**Qualifications** **REQUIREMENTS:**

* Proven working experience of employment\-related laws and regulations in more than one European country: France is mandatory, any of these countries would be highly appreciated: UK, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Finland.

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Benelux) - Orbit Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Amsterdam after. Customer base will be in the Benelux region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**

  

### **Role Description**



As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world's leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis' Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers' business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.


### **Launch Your Enterprise Software Career \- Orbit Graduate program**



Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.



During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.



This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.



Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:


* Discovery \& AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Hackathons \& Prototyping:** Think out of the box, have a "can\-do" attitude and don't shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* **Agentic Process Transformation:** Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule\-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform

### **What You Need:**

* Excellent academic performance

* A customer\-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.

* A proactive approach to problem\-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Hands\-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects

title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data\-informed growth lever \- one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go\-to\-market, from our 1\.5 million\-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.


To do so, here's what you'll own:

**BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING**

* Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness\-to\-pay, gross margin, and customer value.
* Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.
* Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

**DESIGN OUR PRICING \& PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE**

* Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self\-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add\-ons like our startup and charity plans.
* Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption\-based models as our product and cost\-to\-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.
* Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

**DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS**

* Lead cross\-functional pricing decision\-making and secure buy\-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.
* Own the rollout of major pricing changes end\-to\-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.
* Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage\-based billing decisions.

**Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* **Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS**: You have 6\+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat\-based to usage\-based, or a platform repricing.
* **Hands\-on with modern pricing models**: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption\-based, outcome\-based, or AI\-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.
* **Both self\-serve and Enterprise motions**: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self\-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) *and* Enterprise, sales\-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.
* **Deep analytical rigour**: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost\-to\-serve, gross margin, willingness\-to\-pay, and elasticity.
* **Billing fluency, technical and operational**: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true\-ups, and disputes.
* **Empathy for technical users and buyers**: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.
* **Frameworks over bottlenecks**: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.
* **Cross\-functional influence**: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.
* **Motivated by scope, not headcount**: You're energised by owning a global, high\-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* **Formal pricing training**: You've been trained at Simon\-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.
* **Developer tools experience**: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.
* **Open source or freemium background**: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

### **Why join us?**


At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap \- it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low\-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5\.2bn company monetises across community, self\-serve, and Enterprise, in 100\+ countries and across both cloud and self\-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote\-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.


Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?


Apply now \- and help us build the future of automation.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:


	+ **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
	+ **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health \& wellness** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country\-specific details are provided in your contract.*

title: Senior Concept Artist
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main** **challenge**


We are looking for a Concept Artist to support the pre\-production and visual development of our core game titles, creating concepts and artistic references that help align production teams around a clear visual direction. The role focuses on projects inspired by the visual standards of Disney Speedstorm and Asphalt 9\.

**What it means** **on a daily basis**

* **Visual Concept Generation:** Create character designs and illustrations, including line art and 3D blockouts, in line with project requirements and the distinct visual styles of Hyperdrive, Asphalt, and Disney.
* **Creative Ideation:** Generate and develop artistic ideas while maintaining each game's unique visual identity.
* **Collaborative Design:** Collaborate with fellow artists and designers to develop and enhance the game's visual style.
* **Feedback Integration:** Work under the Studio Art Director's guidance, iterate on designs based on feedback, and deliver work in line with project goals and timelines.
* **Art Asset Planning:** Plan the creation of art assets for characters, environments, and props, and clearly communicate the approach and requirements to the relevant team members.

**What** **success will look like**


After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the projects visual directions and production workflows. After 6 months, you will independently deliver concepts and references that support production decisions. You will also contribute consistently to the evolution of the games' visual identity and support effective collaboration across art and design teams.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with concept artists, artists, designers, and production teams. Your concepts and visual references will support local and international collaborators throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment** **journey**

* HR Screen Call: An initial conversation with our HR team.
* First Interview: A 20\-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to discuss your previous projects and experience.
* Test: You will have one week to complete a practical test.
* Second Interview: A discussion with the Hiring Manager to review your test, explore your approach in more detail, and share feedback.
* Final Interview: A meeting with the Studio Manager to discuss alignment and answer any remaining questions.

**Where this role can take you**


This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in concept art, explore broader artistic responsibilities, and access development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in concept art or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio
* Advanced proficiency in Photoshop for digital art creation and proficiency with Blender or similar 3D software for concept development.
* Solid ability to produce clear and efficient sketches and develop concepts for characters, environments, and props.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating closely with artists, designers, and production teams
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

 **Schneider Digital** is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.

  

Schneider Electric is a Fortune 500 global enterprise operating a product\-oriented infrastructure model structured around technical pillars (Network, Compute \& Storage, Cloud, Automation, Monitoring) and supported by a broad ecosystem of strategic vendors. This model enables specialization and execution at scale, but also creates fragmentation risks across prioritization, standards, financial control, vendor management, and service performance.

  

To address these risks, the Global Infrastructure Service Delivery (GISD) is establishing a Transversal Governance Team whose mission is to govern, assure, standardize, prioritize, and escalate — not to become a second operations organization or a reporting factory. Governance defines direction and control; pillars retain delivery ownership.


The ITSM \& Vendor Management Specialist is a hybrid, high\-impact role that bridges service performance (ITSM) discipline with strategic vendor oversight. The role ensures enterprise\-first outcomes, actionable transparency, and effective cross\-functional integration with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and the GTS PMO.

  

While this role combines responsibilities across both ITSM and Vendor Management, we are not seeking a deep subject matter expert in every area. We are looking for a professional with solid experience in one or both disciplines, strong learning agility, adaptability to change, and a willingness to grow alongside a newly established Governance Team.

This is a governance\-focused position rather than a hands\-on infrastructure operations role. The successful candidate will influence outcomes through collaboration, service governance, performance management, and stakeholder engagement across multiple technical pillars. **What will you do?**

title: L&D Coordinator
description:
Graphite is a fully remote vertical AI growth agency. We help clients grow through AEO and SEO\-driven content strategy, powered by a mix of specialized talent and AI tooling built for the way we work. Our team spans Content Specialists, Growth Leads, Growth Directors, and Editors, all supporting client accounts across multiple pods.


We're looking for an L\&D Coordinator to join Graphite's learning and development team. You'll work directly with our L\&D Manager to keep onboarding, training, and internal learning programs running day to day, then grow into building more of that content yourself as you settle in.


We're not looking for someone to just execute a checklist. This role needs a creative problem\-solver who writes well, thinks ahead, and brings ideas for how to do things better, not just someone who completes tasks as assigned. You'll have ownership over how programs get built and communicated, and we want someone who's enthusiastic and curious about using AI to work smarter, whether that's research, dashboards, or automating the repetitive parts of the job.


This is a foundational role on a growing team. Graphite runs L\&D through as a single person team now, and this hire is what lets it scale. You'll start focused on execution: building onboarding materials, tracking program data, and keeping our internal L\&D channel active.


Within your first year, you'll take on more content creation, community\-building, and program facilitation as you learn the business and our programs.

**This is a remote role, open to candidates based in Madrid only at this time.**

**Who you are**

* A clear, engaging writer who can make training content feel practical \& exciting.
* Organized and proactive by nature, you flag problems before they become blockers.
* Genuinely curious, you like figuring out a better way to do something rather than just doing it the way you've always done it.
* Comfortable using AI tools for research, building lightweight dashboards, or automating repetitive work, and excited to find more ways to do that.
* A creative thinker who brings ideas to the table, not just someone who waits to be told what to do.

**What you'll do**

* Build onboarding materials and online programs for new hires across our Growth, Editorial, and other areas across the company, using established templates and frameworks.
* Track completion data, quiz scores, and skill baselines, and keep our reporting trackers current.
* Coordinate logistics for training sessions and workshops: scheduling, reminders, working session setup, and feedback collection.
* Post regular updates to our L\&D Slack channel: session recaps, upcoming sessions, and useful resources for the team.
* Support our intern and shadowing programs with onboarding, tracking, and kickoff logistics.
* Help maintain compliance training materials, including templates for subject\-matter experts and completion tracking.
* As you grow in the role, take on drafting original training content (modules, decks, videos) and help build out a more consistent L\&D content and community presence company\-wide.

**Required experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in training coordination, HR, learning operations, or a related role.
* Strong writing skills, with a portfolio or writing sample that shows range.
* Comfortable working in a Learning Management System (we use Disco) or similar platform.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for research, reporting, or workflow automation, this isn't just familiarity, we want to see how you've actually used them.
* Excellent organizational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
* Genuine interest in learning and development as a career path.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with content creation: writing, video, or presentation design.
* Experience with data collection and analysis, including building charts and reports on training data.
* Familiarity with growth marketing, SEO, or AEO concepts (or willingness to learn them quickly, since our training content covers this space).
* Experience running or contributing to an internal community, newsletter, or knowledge\-sharing initiative.
* Spanish language skills (a plus given our team's regional makeup).

**How we’ll help:**


Graphite’s mission is to create an environment where you build the best work of your career. In order to facilitate this, we provide:

* **Process As Needed** \- We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes as we do products \- through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* **Autonomy** \- We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.
* **Flexible Work Environment** \- Everyone’s optimal work style is unique. We operate as a distributed team across the US, Canada, Latin America, and Europe. We optimize for productivity and performance, not time spent in an office. Help us build an optimal work environment that fits you as an individual.
* **Compensation** \- We want to work with the best people in the World and compensate accordingly.
* **Vacation \& Time Off** \- In order to be the best version of yourself, you need time to recharge. We offer flexible PTO. Take the time when you need it.
* **Benefits** \- We will ensure you have quality healthcare coverage and opportunities to further your education.

title: Customer Complaints Senior Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

**About the Opportunity**
The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We're a team of risk\-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.
In this role, you will own OKX's Global Customer Complaints Program and report directly to the Compliance Chief of Staff. You will work closely with Local Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams to promote consistent complaint handling across jurisdictions, maintain alignment with regulatory requirements, and provide effective second\-line oversight and challenge.
A key part of the role will be turning customer complaints into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence. You will oversee complaints governance and quality assurance, identify trends and potential systemic issues, support root\-cause analysis and remediation, and provide senior leadership with clear reporting on customer outcomes and emerging risks.
You will also support the development, coordination, and tracking of responses to regulators, working directly with Legal and Local Compliance teams on regulatory inquiries, escalated complaints, and related supervisory matters. This requires strong regulatory judgment, excellent written communication, and the ability to coordinate complex matters across multiple teams and jurisdictions.

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop, coordinate, and track responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and escalated complaints, partnering with Legal and Local Compliance teams to gather and validate facts, prepare clear and defensible responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments, remediation, and follow\-up through closure.
* Maintain global regulatory alignment by partnering with local Heads of Compliance to identify changes in jurisdictional requirements and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and local requirements remain current and appropriately implemented.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service\-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed\-loop validation.
* Own the second\-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk\-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer\-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
* Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
* Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
* Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
* Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.

**What We Look For In You**
* Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
* Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
* Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi\-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
* Strong regulatory and customer\-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer\-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
* Demonstrated experience with root\-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
* Strong second\-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk\-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.

**Nice\-To\-Haves**
* Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
* Familiarity with complaints\-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute\-resolution bodies.
* Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP\-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

title: Ads Specialist
description:
**Hola Crack!**
---------------


Buscamos a nuestro próximo Social Ads Specialist para Atlas— alguien que no separa datos de creatividad, porque sabe que van de la mano. Ojo analítico para detectar qué está funcionando, instinto para convertirlo en la próxima pieza, y las ganas de que cada campaña sea mejor que la anterior.


Si un número te dice tanto como una buena idea, y eres de los resolutivos que no esperan a que se lo pidan… bienvenido/a a la manada.

**¿Quienes somos?**
-------------------


Todo el mundo cuenta la historia bonita de startup. La nuestra no es esa.


Somos Ucademy: empezamos en 2022, cuando Ramiro y Pablo volvieron de Bali con una idea y ni un euro de inversión externa. Vino un año de crecer demasiado rápido, otro de puro aguante — y en 2025 arrancó un crecimiento real, del 200% interanual. Hoy, en 2026, con cinco años cumplidos y la casa en orden, somos una manada que va a muerte de verdad.


Dentro de esa manada está Atlas, nuestra academia online de Selectividad, PCE y Acceso \+25, con un 97% de alumnos en su primera opción de carrera. Y detrás de esa cifra hay campañas que funcionan todos los días — buscamos a alguien que no separe datos de creatividad: capaz de convertir métricas en decisiones y necesidades de campaña en piezas creativas.

**‍‍ ¿Con quién trabajarás?**
-----------------------------

* **Irene Seguer** (Head of Marketing)
* **Carlota Fernández** (Brand Specialist)
* **Michelangelo Iossa** (Social Ads Specialist)
* **Marta Varela** (Marketing Specialist)

**Tu misión**
-------------


Serás el puente entre el reporting diario, la optimización táctica de campañas, y la producción creativa junto a Brand. Vigilarás de cerca cómo van las campañas, detectarás desviaciones antes de que sean un problema, ajustarás lo que haga falta ajustar, y ayudarás a que las nuevas creatividades salgan a tiempo.


Aquí vas a aprender haciendo, no observando.

**Qué harás**
-------------

**Reporting** — Ser los ojos de la manada en el día a día de las campañas.  

Revisarás a diario las métricas de las campañas activas en Meta, TikTok y Google (spend, CPL, CAC, CTR). Actualizarás dashboards y reportes de seguimiento. Detectarás pronto cualquier desviación y la escalarás al responsable de Paid.

**️ Optimización de campañas** — Pasar de "veo un problema" a "lo soluciono".  

Harás ajustes tácticos sobre campañas en curso: pausar o escalar anuncios según rendimiento, rotar creatividades fatigadas, revisar segmentaciones y pujas. Aplicarás lo aprendido en el reporting diario para mantener el CAC dentro de objetivo.

**Colaboración con Brand**  

Participarás activamente en el sprint semanal de creatividades: trasladarás a Brand qué formatos o ángulos necesita Paid según lo que está funcionando. Apoyarás en el diseño de piezas (estáticas y vídeo) y en la redacción de guiones y copies. Ayudarás a preparar los creativos para su lanzamiento en cada plataforma.

**Cómo se verá el éxito**
-------------------------

**30 días — tus primeros pasos en la jungla**

* Te integras en la operativa diaria de Paid.
* Reportas de manera autónoma sobre las campañas.
* Entregas y activas tu primera pieza creativa en campaña.


Objetivo: demostrar que dominas las métricas clave, conoces las plataformas y aportas valor desde ya, aunque con supervisión.

**60 días — moverte solo por el terreno**

* Gestionas el reporting y la optimización táctica sin depender de otros.

title: Excellence & Execution Head

The Execution Excellence Head leads the enterprise\-wide evolution of execution standards across the product lifecycle, from two years pre\-launch through loss of exclusivity. This role serves as a strategic partner to the Country President, Finance, and People \& Organization leadership, driving business performance, medical and access effectiveness, and future growth ambitions through data\-driven decision\-making, innovative go\-to\-market strategies, digital transformation, capability building, and continuous execution excellence improvement.

### **About the Role**

In this pivotal leadership role, you will shape how Novartis delivers excellence across customer engagement, insight generation, digital transformation, field effectiveness, and organizational capability development. You will anticipate market and ecosystem shifts, translate global strategies into impactful local execution, and continuously elevate execution standards through external benchmarking, innovation, and operational excellence.


You will lead a high\-performing organization spanning five core capabilities:

* Field Excellence
* Integrated Insights
* Data, Analytics \& Platforms (DAP)
* Capability Building
* Customer Excellence

  

Together, these teams enable superior execution, optimized resource allocation, enhanced customer experiences, and sustainable business performance across the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

### **Enterprise Execution Excellence Leadership**

* Lead the continuous evolution, harmonization, and elevation of execution excellence standards across the organization.

* Translate global execution excellence strategies, frameworks, and capabilities into successful local implementation.

* Drive organizational effectiveness, transformation, and future readiness through innovative operating models and capabilities.

### **Field Excellence**
