* Coordinate closely with Group Tax, Divisional Finance, Local Finance, IT and Commercial stakeholders to drive effective implementation, resolve operational issues and ensure timely execution of required actions.
* Communicate transfer pricing impacts, performance and required actions clearly to senior stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into practical business implications and recommendations.
* Support transfer pricing audits and documentation requirements where necessary, ensuring appropriate data, controls and supporting evidence are maintained across relevant entities and processes.
* Drive continuous improvement across transfer pricing processes, systems and controls, identifying opportunities to enhance automation, data governance, reporting quality and operational efficiency.
* Provide strategic and practical transfer pricing expertise across the business, balancing OECD requirements and transfer pricing policy with the realities of finance processes, systems and day\-to\-day commercial operations.

* Strong understanding of the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, operational transfer pricing concepts, profitability monitoring, transfer pricing adjustments and policy implementation.
* Proven experience implementing transfer pricing solutions within ERP environments and translating transfer pricing requirements into practical, sustainable system and process solutions.
* Strong understanding of finance processes, management reporting and controlling, with the ability to connect transfer pricing requirements with broader finance and business processes.

* Strong project management and implementation skills, with a hands\-on, execution\-oriented approach and the ability to drive initiatives from design through to operational delivery.

title: ISX Partner Coach, RLS, Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In France, we deliver that experience across more than 15,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience\-led options such as Label\-Free, Box\-Free (LFBF) drop\-off and every other way a customer can return an item in\-store.  

  

The ISX Regional Program Manager, France owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole French network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in\-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.  

  

This is not only a field\-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network\-wide improvements that lift the entire Italian network at once: in\-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in Italy, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on\-the\-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.  

  

This is also a founding, build\-from\-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager for France and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the in\-store returns experience in Spain across \~14,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
* Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
* Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
* Deploy network\-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in\-store signage and way finding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns\-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
* Shape strategy from the field. Turn on\-the\-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU\-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
* Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow\-up cycle for under performing sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
* Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the French market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.

  

A day in the life  

You start the week by reviewing performance data for Spain and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk\-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the French rollout of a new signage standard and a store\-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re\-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.  

  

About the team  

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end\-to\-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse\-logistics networks in retail.  

  

Within RLS, the In\-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.  

  

Our culture is hands\-on, data\-driven, and high\-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works — because the best decisions about in\-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Relevant experience in operations, field operations, retail, logistics, or program management experience.
* Experience improving performance across a large, distributed multi\-site or partner network using data to prioritize where to focus.
* Experience coaching, influencing, or holding external partners accountable without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating independently in an ambiguous, build\-from\-scratch environment and prioritizing the highest\-impact work without a fully defined playbook.
* Willingness to travel frequently within Spain and to work hands\-on in an operational store/drop\-off environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* In\-store retail operations experience, field operations, retail, logistics or program management experience
* Experience in reverse logistics, returns, last\-mile, or third\-party partner/carrier operations, ideally in the EU.
* Experience standing up new programs, teams, or country operations (founding\-member experience).
* Experience designing or deploying operational programs across a partner network, not just managing execution at the site level.
* Familiarity with field auditing, coaching, and structured performance\-management cycles.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent operational experience

title: Mid-level Artist - Architectural Visualisation
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


You know that feeling when a scene finally clicks? The composition settles, the light does exactly what it needs to do, and the image becomes more than a technically accurate model. It becomes a place people can believe in.


For over two decades, we've been making images of places that don't exist yet \- and making people feel them. Stills, films, VR experiences. Work that helps architects, developers and brands turn an idea into something people understand, remember and want to be part of.


That's the standard. That's what keeps us interested.


We're a studio of artists, directors, technical pioneers and obsessives. People who care about the fall of light at 4pm. Or whether a material feels touched by real life. Or the fine line between an image that's polished and one that's genuinely convincing.

#### **What we're really looking for**


We need someone who's moved beyond the basics and is ready to own their part of the work.


You can take a brief, drawings and references and turn them into a strong visual response. You understand composition, light, materials and atmosphere \- and you know that technical skill only matters when it serves the story.


You can work with minimal supervision, manage a project component from setup through delivery and spot problems before they become blockers. You know when to solve something yourself and when asking the right question will move the whole team forward faster.


You're comfortable with feedback because you know it makes the work better. And you're beginning to give useful feedback too \- sharing what you know with junior artists without ego or fuss.


You're reliable when timelines tighten and priorities shift. You stay organised, communicate clearly and keep the quality high without losing sight of the deadline.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Create work with impact.** You'll deliver high\-quality architectural visualisation across stills, animation and VR, translating creative direction and technical information into images that feel clear, compelling and real.

**Own your part of the project.** You'll independently manage assigned scenes, sequences or project components \- planning your time, tracking milestones and taking the work through review to final delivery.

**Solve the problems in front of you.** You'll identify and resolve technical and creative issues efficiently, self\-check your work and escalate early when a decision or extra support is needed.

**Keep everyone connected.** You'll work closely with senior leads, project managers, artists, clients and external partners, communicating progress, blockers and handovers clearly.

**Make the team stronger.** You'll support junior artists and interns, share techniques and pipeline knowledge, and contribute thoughtful feedback in critiques and peer reviews.

**Protect the process.** You'll maintain clean files and scenes, follow best\-practice workflows and help improve consistency across the production pipeline.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**A portfolio that shows your judgement.** Not just polished images, but work that demonstrates composition, light, materials, atmosphere and your ability to translate a brief into a visual story.

**Proven production experience.** You'll have delivered work for 3D environments and understand the end\-to\-end CGI workflow well enough to manage your own tasks and support others.

**Strong technical skills.** A confident working knowledge of Autodesk 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and Adobe Creative Cloud, along with the general technical fluency to learn new tools as projects evolve.

**Independent thinking.** You can work through complex tasks with minimal supervision, anticipate issues and turn difficult projects into useful learning.

**Clear communication.** You can explain progress, decisions and technical concepts to colleagues, clients and external stakeholders \- and adapt your approach to the person in front of you.

**Leadership without the title.** You're happy to guide junior artists, share what you know and help a small team deliver under the direction of senior leads.

**That thing you can't teach.** You care about the work, the people around you and getting the details right. It matters to you.

#### **What we'll give you**

**The setup to do your best work.** Clear creative direction, capable production support and experienced senior artists and leads who share your standards.

**More ownership.** Real responsibility for meaningful parts of ambitious projects, with the backing to make decisions, solve problems and see your work through.

**Support to evolve.** Space to deepen your craft, test better approaches and build the creative and leadership skills that will take you to the next level.

**Open conversations.** Kind, specific feedback and fast decisions that keep the work moving and help you keep improving.

**A global creative community.** Access to brilliant people across our studios, bringing different perspectives, specialist skills and new ways of working.

**Trust.** You'll have autonomy over your work, accountability for the outcome and support when you need it.

#### **Benefits**

* Mental Health \& Wellbeing support through HealthShield and SpectrumLife
* Great learning \& development opportunities
* Fun and collaborative office environment in Camden
* Long service leave policy (one extra day of leave for every year of service)
* ️‍️ Corporate Gym Scheme
* Monthly health and wellness allowance
* ️ Remote working policy
* Regular team events and social activities
* Dog friendly office

Your impact
You will help shape how complex bridges and structures are designed, assessed and delivered across major UK and international infrastructure programmes.

Whether your strengths are in technical leadership, project delivery, team development or a combination of these areas, you will bring experience that strengthens the team, builds client confidence and improves project outcomes.
  

  

**About the opportunity**

  

  

You will join Jacobs’ Bridges and Structures capability within its wider Transportation business, working across highways, rail, aviation, energy and power. The team supports technically complex UK and international programmes for clients including High Speed 2, National Highways, Network Rail, the Welsh Government, national contractors and local authorities. You will contribute across the project lifecycle, including structural analysis, feasibility, tender development, preliminary and detailed design, contract documentation and technical reporting.


You will lead and support multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with colleagues across the UK, Europe and Jacobs’ global delivery network, and build trusted relationships with clients. You will also help introduce practical digital, automated and standardised approaches that improve quality and efficiency. Success will mean delivering technically robust and sustainable structural solutions, developing capable engineering teams and helping clients make informed decisions on complex infrastructure challenges.


Here's what you'll need  

  

We are open to candidates whose strengths are primarily in technical leadership, project or discipline management, or a combination of these areas. You do not need to demonstrate an identical balance across every aspect of the role.

  

  

* Substantial experience in bridge or structural engineering within infrastructure, transportation or a closely related environment.

* Experience contributing to the delivery of structural engineering projects through one or more key stages, such as feasibility, tender, preliminary design, detailed design, assessment or renewal.
* The ability to make sound engineering decisions and communicate technical risks, options and recommendations clearly.
* Experience coordinating with clients, engineering disciplines and project stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.
* A relevant civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent technical competence developed through substantial professional experience.
  

  

**Why Join Us?**

  

  

**Work on complex infrastructure challenges**

  

  

You will contribute to bridges and structures across several sectors, including highways, rail, aviation, energy and power. This provides broader technical exposure than a role limited to one asset type or market.

  

  

**Influence how engineering is delivered**

  

  

This is not purely a production or project management position. You will have the opportunity to improve working methods, introduce useful digital approaches and influence how structural engineering services are delivered.

  

  

**Develop people and technical capability**

  

  

You will support engineers through technical leadership, mentoring and project delivery. This creates an opportunity to build your own profile while helping develop the next generation of engineering capability.

  

  

**Access a wider technical network**

  

  

Collaboration across Jacobs’ UK, European and global teams could provide access to specialist knowledge, varied project experience and opportunities to contribute beyond a single local portfolio.

  

  

**Build a long\-term professional path**

  

  

The breadth of the role could support progression through technical leadership, project leadership, discipline management or client development. The final advert should define the specific progression routes available at this grade rather than leaving candidates to infer them.

  

  

  

\#Trasnportation \#Bridges \#LI\-DC1

  

  

Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. title: AI Image Specialist
description:
**Own AI image generation for a $1Billion\+ brand. Produce hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard consistently, at production volume.** 




  





**Up to AED 20,000/month (tax\-free) \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base** 




  





**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (On\-site) with relocation assistance and visa support
 



  





**Growth path** 
 from here is Senior AI Image Specialist → AI Creative Lead. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 GPT Image and Nano Banana Pro are part of the working creative stack, and AI\-generated imagery is used in live production work rather than kept to internal tests. You'd be building on a foundation, not evangelising one.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring an AI Image Specialist to own AI image generation for Puffy.com, covering photorealistic hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery across ecommerce and marketing, owning the prompting approaches, reference workflows and production standards behind it, reporting directly to the UX/UI Design Lead.
 



  





 This role exists to make AI generation dependable enough to serve as the production route, building the prompting approaches, reference libraries and quality standards that allow brand\-standard imagery to be produced at volume and to a predictable result.
 



  





**The Problems You'll Own:** 



* **Primary: Consistency at brand standard:** 
 Producing one strong AI image is straightforward. Producing them consistently is not. You'll be responsible for hero, lifestyle and advertising imagery that meets brand standard every time, with an actual Puffy mattress rendered accurately inside a fully generated environment. Every image is judged on whether it delivers the objective in the brief, not on how it looks in isolation. The work is making AI generation dependable enough to be the production route.
* **Secondary: Raise what the whole team can produce:** 
 The second outcome of this role is what the wider Design team can do. You'll develop the best practices, prompting techniques, reusable reference workflows and quality standards that let existing designers produce work to a comparable standard, raising the creative output of the whole team alongside your own.



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 This is not a role where you execute prompts written by someone else and pass the output on for finishing. The scope is scarce: very few AI image specialists hold simultaneous ownership of the prompting approaches, the reference workflows, the production standards, and the adoption of all three across an entire design team, with a direct line to the UX/UI Design Lead and no layers in between.
 



  





**Your first 12 months:** 
 build and refine the AI\-assisted workflows behind Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery, with photorealism and product accuracy as the bar. Develop reusable prompting approaches and reference\-image workflows for recurring creative needs. Establish the production standards that keep output consistent at brand standard. Create and test AI\-generated and AI\-enhanced advertising creative in partnership with the Growth team. Take AI outputs through compositing and retouching to production\-ready final creative. Evaluate new image\-generation tools and models and introduce those that materially improve quality or efficiency. Share the best practices that accelerate AI adoption across the wider Design team. Shape the future of creative production at Puffy, where imagery carries the product across every commercial surface.
 



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another AI design role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Production Standard, Not Only the Output** 




 You set the prompting approaches, build the reference workflows, and decide when an image is ready to ship.
 


* You determine how Puffy product, hero and lifestyle imagery is produced: the prompting techniques, the reference\-image workflows, the compositional control, and the retouching route that takes a generation through to production\-ready final creative. You assess which tools and models earn a place in the stack.
* You hold the standard an image is measured against, on both the objective stated in the brief and on brand consistency. You report directly to the UX/UI Design Lead, who sets creative direction and holds that bar with you.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organisation and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
 



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Experience a World\-Class Lifestyle** 




 Dubai offers a tax\-free salary, world\-class infrastructure, year\-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.
 



  





**4\. Become the Specialist Whose AI Work Reaches Production** 




 In most companies, AI imagery remains a proof of concept: presented internally, rarely trusted on a live storefront. Here, your output publishes to a $1Billion\+ ecommerce site and into paid creative carrying real media budget. When a page requires a hero image, or a campaign requires creative that responds to what the performance data shows, your work is what ships. You'll build the systematic control to reproduce a winning output on demand rather than regenerating until something lands, and the commercial judgment to make an image serve the objective it was briefed against. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a stock library and a retouching backlog in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating high\-quality commercial AI\-generated imagery, particularly photorealistic product and lifestyle imagery.



  





**AI generation and editing** 



* Advanced hands\-on proficiency with ChatGPT Images / GPT Image models for image generation, editing, iteration and creative development.
* Advanced hands\-on proficiency with Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) for professional image generation and editing.
* Strong proficiency across the wider generative\-image landscape: Midjourney, FLUX/Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Adobe Firefly or equivalent platforms.
* Advanced prompt engineering and visual prompting, including reference images and multimodal inputs, together with strong image\-to\-image, inpainting, outpainting, compositional\-control and iterative\-editing workflows.



  





**Craft and production** 



* Places an existing physical product into generated environments without losing product fidelity.
* Works systematically enough to reproduce a winning output on demand, rather than regenerating until something lands.
* Advanced Photoshop, compositing and retouching capability to take AI outputs through to production\-ready final creative.
* Fundamentals: composition, lighting, perspective, color, visual hierarchy, art direction.
* Commercial output
* Delivers hero, lifestyle, ecommerce and paid creative to a brief with a stated marketing objective, not just attractive images.
* Reads a creative brief commercially and makes the calls that serve the objective.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* DTC / ecommerce experience — especially creating product and performance\-marketing imagery for consumer brands.
* Photography, CGI or 3D experience — strong understanding of lighting, composition, materials and photorealistic product visualization.
* Experience building and sharing AI creative workflows — including reusable prompts, reference libraries, templates or training that helps other designers adopt AI more effectively.



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First** 
 : Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





 ✨
 **Your Total Compensation \& Benefits** 




 💰
 **Compensation:** 



* Up to AED 20,000/month (tax\-free) \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base
* Annual salary review every January
* Tax\-free income
* Annual return flight allowance to your home country
* Parking allowance (up to AED 7,800 annually)



  





 🏥
 **Health \& Protection:** 



* Premium worldwide health coverage (AED 1 Million limit)

 🌴
 **Time Off:** 



* 22 working days annual leave \+ UAE public holidays



  





 🌍
 **Relocation Support (International Hires):** 



* UAE work visa sponsorship
* International flights \& airport transfers
* 14\-day 4\-star hotel accommodation



  





 💼
 **Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Premium office environment in Dubai Internet City
* Up to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certifications
* International team collaboration, 16\+ nationalities in one office. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

title: Director, Creative Services - Pottery Barn
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Photo Direction Team**
 Housed within Pottery Barn’s Creative department, the Photo Direction team translates the brand’s creative
   

  

 vision into compelling photography and videography that inspires our customers to decorate, entertain, and
   

  

 live beautifully in a home that reflects their individual style.
   

  

 Supporting Pottery Barn’s omni\-channel business, the team concepts, develops and executes the photographic vision for each season, creating beautiful, distinctive and consistently on\-brand imagery across digital, social, print, marketing, advertising and in\-store channels. We foster a highly collaborative, creative and positive environment and partner closely across Creative, Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Video and Social Media.
   

  

**Overview Of The Creative Director Role**
 The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for driving and creating Pottery Barn’s seasonal
   

  

 photographic vision, ensuring that the brand’s visual expression is distinctive, inspiring and consistent
   

  

 across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 Working closely with the Senior Vice President of Creative and Vice President of Creative and Photography,
   

  

 the Creative Director translates brand, product and seasonal direction into compelling visual concepts and
   

  

 establishes the creative framework that guides photography, video and related content.
   

  

 This role sees the big picture and is also responsible for executing the details. You are a
   

  

 sophisticated visual storyteller with a strong point of view on interiors, decorating, photography, styling and
   

  

 culture—and understand where Pottery Barn sits in that intersection.
   

  

 You also understand how to translate product and brand ideas into imagery that creates emotion,
   

  

 communicates a clear point of view and ultimately builds desire for the Pottery Barn brand. You have the ability to
   

  

 create compelling individual images while simultaneously knowing how to create cohesive images that form a campaign.
   

  

 The Creative Director leads and inspires Art Directors and extended creative teams while partnering with
   

  

 photographers, stylists, producers, set designers and cross\-functional leaders to bring seasonal campaigns
   

  

 and ongoing brand storytelling to life.
   

  

 You will report to the Vice President, Creative and Photography and work closely with the Senior Vice
   

  

 President of Creative.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with the SVP and VP of Creative to establish the overarching photographic and visual direction for seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives and key storytelling moments.
* Participate in seasonal concept showroom walk\-throughs and Product Development meetings to understand the product vision, key stories and priorities for each season.
* Translate seasonal product and brand direction into a clear creative vision that establishes the overall mood, storytelling approach, visual language and photographic point of view.
* With oversight from Vice President, Creative and Photography, lead the development and review of seasonal Creative Briefs, ensuring concepts reflect the intended brand vision and provide clear direction for Art Directors, photographers, stylists, producers and other creative partners.
* Establish and maintain Pottery Barn's photographic standards and overall visual "look and feel," ensuring consistency while continually evolving the brand's imagery.
* Provide creative leadership across multiple campaigns, shoots and seasonal chapters, maintaining a holistic view of how individual assets work together to create a cohesive customer experience.
* Guide Art Directors in developing decorating concepts, styling direction, camera approaches, lighting, set design and other visual elements that bring the approved creative direction to life.
* Partner with the VP Creative on photographer, stylist and creative talent selection based on the needs and visual objectives of each campaign.
* Review and guide set concepts and environmental storytelling to ensure rooms and spaces communicate a strong Pottery Barn point of view and appropriately showcase product.
* Provide senior\-level creative direction during key photography and video shoots, guiding mood, tone, composition, lighting, styling and overall visual execution.
* Inspire and develop Art Directors and broader creative teams, providing clear feedback, mentorship and creative guidance while fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Build productive creative partnerships with photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other external and internal creative talent.
* Partner closely with Merchandising and Product Development to ensure creative storytelling and product representation are aligned while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.
* Collaborate with E\-Commerce, Social, Video, Marketing and other channel partners to ensure the photographic vision translates effectively across customer touchpoints.
* Partner with Pagination and Creative teams to ensure imagery supports compelling layouts, storytelling and seasonal content needs.
* Review photography and video throughout the creative process, providing senior\-level direction on image selection, color, retouching, backgrounds, cropping, layouts and overall visual consistency.
* Anticipate creative challenges and proactively identify solutions that balance brand vision, product priorities, production realities and business needs.
* Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, curiosity and excellence while helping evolve Pottery Barn's visual expression and brand relevance.


**Criteria**
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in a visual or creative discipline such as advertising, interior design, interior architecture, graphic design, fine art or photography.
* Significant progressive creative leadership experience within photography, art direction, styling, editorial, advertising or related visual disciplines.
* Deep experience within home furnishings, lifestyle, interiors, retail, editorial or a similarly design\-driven industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate an overarching creative vision and translate brand\-level concepts into compelling visual storytelling.
* Exceptional visual judgment with a sophisticated understanding of interiors, decorating, styling, composition, photography, color and design.
* Proven ability to lead, inspire and develop Art Directors and multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Experience directing photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other creative partners.
* Strong conceptual thinker who can move fluidly between high\-level creative strategy and detailed visual execution.
* Ability to articulate creative ideas clearly and persuasively to creative teams, cross\-functional partners and senior executives.
* Highly collaborative, with demonstrated success partnering across Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Social, Video and other functions.
* Resourceful and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple creative initiatives and changing priorities while maintaining a consistently high visual standard.
* Strong understanding of the home furnishings and décor landscape with knowledge of current and emerging trends in interiors, photography, design and culture.
* Proven proficiency working within a digital\-first creative environment, including familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and contemporary creative workflows.
* Above all, you bring exceptional taste, strong creative instincts and a clear point of view, paired with the leadership skills to inspire others and translate Pottery Barn's brand vision into imagery that feels relevant, beautiful and unmistakably Pottery Barn.


**Our Culture \& Values**
 We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.
   

  

**People First**
 Putting People First means investing in overall well\-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:
   

  

**Benefits**
* A generous discount on all WSI brands
* A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
* Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
* Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same\-sex domestic partner benefits
* Tax\-free commuter benefits
* A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


**Continued Learning**
* In\-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
* Cross\-brand and cross\-function career opportunities
* Resources for self\-development
* Advisor (Mentor) program
* Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H\-1B or other employment\-based immigration).
   

  

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.
   

  

 Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.
   

  

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $140,000\-$175,000\. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.
   

  

**About Us**
 Our Company
   

  

 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark \& Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully\-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick\-and\-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high\-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi\-brand, multi\-channel, global enterprise supported by state\-of\-the\-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing \- and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

title: Senior Project Manager (Large Infrastructure Improvement Projects)
description:
#### **Statement of Duties**


The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing and coordinating large, complex infrastructure improvement projects. The projects will be driven by major utility improvements and include other required work, such as streetscape improvements, private utility relocation, pipeline rehabilitation, and stormwater management projects. This position coordinates, directs, and communicates all activities involved in the implementation and completion of planning, design and construction projects including but not limited to: defining and controlling scope, schedule, budget, design review, and construction compliance.

#### **Essential Functions:**


The essential functions or duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various type of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position.

* Ensure that projects are designed, constructed, and completed in accordance with:
	+ Project goals established by the Infrastructure \& Asset Management Department in coordination with other City departments and stakeholders with respect to quality of work, schedule, and budget.
	+ Applicable Federal, State, and local regulations and design standards.
* Responsible for supervising the work of consultants and contractors
* Manage, organize, coordinate, and monitor consulting teams of assigned projects including relationships with design professionals and contractors.
* Drive performance of consultants, design professionals, and construction management representatives by integrating into the project team and understanding underlying organizational goals.
* Work with Administration \& Finance to:
	+ Manage the Massachusetts General Law requirements for public procurement of services, including design professionals and construction contractors,
	+ Understand funding source(s), inform a project budget, feedback loop to design consultants the Capital Investment Plan.
	+ Track project budget, approve invoices, and spending schedules.
* Works with other City departments in varying capacities from incorporating requirement and standards of practice to informing them of the project.
* Thinks critically about the project including identifying risks, problem solving, researching and implementing best practices, etc.
* Works to identify areas of synergy or impacts with other city projects and initiatives through independent initiative and formal structures including coordination meeting and via construction liaison.
* Exhibit judgment and ingenuity to develop new or adapt existing methods and approaches for accomplishing objectives or to deal with new or unusual requirements within the limits of the guidelines or policies.
* Interact with utility companies and other governmental agencies to coordinate work and obtain necessary permits, clearances, and applicable regulatory compliance requirements.
* Meet and work with elected officials, community representatives, business owners, residents, and other stakeholders to review proposed projects and activities, address questions and comments and educate community on the value and need for proposed projects.
* Through an understanding of departmental goals, assist supervisory and director level staff with project portfolio analysis, including planning of near\-term improvement projects, forecasting costs, making scope change recommendations, and helping translate the greater capital improvement plan into individual projects.
* Assisting supervisory and director level staff with cyclical reporting efforts including departmental goals, regulatory required reporting, and budgetary updates.
* Provide guidance, assistance, and recommendations to staff within the Engineering and IAM Departments relative to the design and construction of large\-scale utility infrastructure projects;
* Responsible for full scope of public engagement including, but not limited to, leading public meetings outside of regular work hours, authoring information pamphlets, presentations, website updates, and communications content.
* Makes presentations to City Council as well as resident advocacy groups and special interest groups.
* Coordinates and performs safety inspections on active construction projects;
* Coordinates with private developers on utility infrastructure.
* Supervise and mentor engineering project managers and staff.
* Demonstrate continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, and streamline work processes.
* Analyze and prepare written reports on program and project performance using quantitative and qualitative analyses and other project management techniques.

#### **Recommended Minimum Qualifications:**

**Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Environmental Engineering or Construction Management with five to seven (5\-7\) years of related work experience; or any equivalent combination of education, training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Special Requirements:**

* Create exhibits, graphics, and visualizations to support bid reviews and project planning.
* Coordinate closely with estimators, project managers, field operations personnel, and other project stakeholders.
* Present earthwork models, quantity analyses, and findings to project teams and leadership.

**Education**

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Director of Engineering, EV/BESS
description:
**About Us**
Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification\-as\-a\-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.

Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle\-to\-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost\-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.  

### **Role Summary**



The Director of Engineering leads Highland's engineering and design team — drafting, project engineering, and utility interconnection — that supports a fast\-moving portfolio of EV charging, battery energy storage (BESS), and edge compute sites from qualified sites through construction\-ready.



This leader owns the engineering standards, the design package content and quality gates, and the throughput of the entire function, and partners with Project Development to deliver build\-ready sites at portfolio scale and on an aggressive timeline.



Reporting to the Vice President, Development \& Construction, the Director builds and leads a team of internal and external engineering resources. The Director serves as Highland's senior technical authority on utility and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, owns the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget, and builds the standards, playbooks, and tooling that make design faster, more repeatable, and more cost\-effective.



This position is remote with an expectation of approximately 10\-15% travel.



### **Responsibilities Overview:**


* Lead and scale Highland's project engineering function — drafting, design engineering, and utility interconnection — with end\-to\-end accountability for taking a large portfolio of EV charging, BESS, and edge compute sites from qualified site to permit\-ready and construction\-ready.
* Own the engineering function's throughput and quality: define the design package content and the internal approval gates for every stage — conceptual, 30%, Issued\-for\-Permit (IFP), and Issued for Construction (IFC) — and keep packages moving on an aggressive, portfolio\-wide timeline.
* Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing team of internal engineering resources
* Own Highland's external engineering\-partner strategy — select, contract, scale, and manage the performance of engineering design and interconnection consultants so that internal and external capacity flex with portfolio volume.
* Set and enforce Highland's engineering, CAD, and design specifications and standards, and own the repositories of utility and AHJ requirements that make design compliant, consistent, and repeatable across the portfolio.
* Serve as Highland's senior technical authority on utility interconnection and AHJ permitting across EV charging, BESS, and edge compute; resolve the most complex technical and jurisdictional issues and represent Highland's engineering position externally.
* Own the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget — sequence and resource design, interconnection, and permitting milestones so each site is build\-ready when construction needs it, and contribute to Highland's repeatable unit\-cost installation model.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Development, Execution, Origination, Procurement, and Fleet Operations to align engineering with portfolio priorities and continuously improve the site\-to\-energized process.
* Drive continuous improvement through tooling and process automation (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, template\- and data\-driven design) to increase design velocity and improve unit economics as the portfolio scales.
* Provide engineering leadership on technical due diligence, estimating, and risk for new opportunities, supporting Origination and Development on feasibility, buildability, and cost.
### **Qualifications:**


**Required**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline, or 12\+ years of directly related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of progressive engineering experience in EV charging, renewable energy, power/electrical infrastructure, or utility\-scale development, including design management from concept through construction.
* 5\+ years leading engineering teams, including managing managers and building or scaling a design organization.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering standards, design package content, and QA/QC across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
* Proven experience selecting, contracting, and managing external engineering consultants at scale.
* Deep working knowledge of utility interconnection, new electrical service, and AHJ permitting requirements.
* Familiarity with interconnection standards and processes (e.g., IEEE 1547, utility tariffs, and interconnection rules).
* Expertise with CAD\-based design delivery (AutoCAD) and design/review tooling (Procore, Bluebeam).


**Preferred**


* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* Experience delivering EV charging infrastructure, BESS, and/or edge compute / data\-center power projects.
* Experience building repeatable, unit\-cost\-driven design programs in a high\-growth environment.
* Master's degree in engineering or an MBA.
**What You Can Expect from Highland:**
* Competitive base salary and performance\-based bonus program
* A supportive, highly collaborative, team\-oriented environment
* Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward\-thinking colleagues
* Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees \& their dependents

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

title: Associate Director, Product Safety & Compliance
description:
**The Opportunity**


Caraway Home is looking for an experienced Associate Director, Product Safety \& Compliance to build our product compliance function from the ground up and own what we call the Caraway Promise, a testing\-obsessed, transparency\-first approach to product safety that sets the bar for the industry. The Caraway Promise exists because we believe in transparency, not because the industry requires transparency.


This is a foundational role, the first dedicated compliance hire at Caraway, responsible for building the frameworks, lab relationships, testing strategy, supply chain diligence, claims substantiation, and regulatory sequencing across a diverse and growing product portfolio. You will own the full compliance lifecycle across Caraway's product categories (cookware, bakeware, electrical items, food contact materials, textiles, and packaging), always meeting or exceeding the most stringent applicable global standard to establish industry\-leading Caraway protocols and procedures. You will be US\-based, work closely with Asia\-based suppliers and third\-party labs (particularly in China), and build the internal systems and processes that let Caraway scale compliantly, credibly, and with confidence.


Additionally, an important responsibility of this role is disseminating key information, labels, and results to support marketing initiatives. You need to be a strong communicator, working collaboratively with cross functional teams, to broadcast and showcase the diligence Caraway is taking across its entire product portfolio in regards to compliance, being able to assist with crafting accurate, transparent, educational and understandable language and messaging that resonates with our consumer.


This position reports to our Director, Product Development.

**Who You Are**


You have ten or more years of product safety and regulatory compliance experience in consumer goods, ideally grounded in chemistry, materials science, or applied laboratory research, with deep expertise in food contact materials, cookware, kitchen appliances, or an adjacent hard goods category. You know FDA, LFGB, EU Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004, REACH, CA Prop 65, CA AB 1200, NSF, FSC, and CPSC requirements not as acronyms on a checklist, but as frameworks you've navigated hands\-on, including where global standards diverge. You’ll use this fluency to scale the Caraway Promise internationally: building a testing and compliance framework that anticipates global standards.


You are a builder and a scientist at heart, ready to own a compliance program entirely: selecting labs, building testing matrices, writing material certification requirements, establishing supplier audit cadences, and designing the studies needed to substantiate product claims. You operate comfortably across cultures and time zones, with direct experience working with labs and manufacturers in Asia, particularly China. You communicate complex science and regulatory requirements clearly to internal teams (Product, Marketing, Legal, Supply Chain) and external partners alike, and you see internal education as core to the job.

**Responsibilities**

* Own and pioneer the Caraway Standard: define and champion a testing\-obsessed, transparency\-first approach to product safety that goes beyond what regulation requires, because we believe our customers deserve it.
* Build Caraway's product safety and compliance program, defining frameworks, documentation standards, testing protocols, regulatory calendars, and governance processes across all product categories (cookware, bakeware, small appliances, food contact materials, textiles, and packaging); integrate compliance across the full product lifecycle, from development and supplier onboarding through market placement, ongoing monitoring, and end\-of\-life.
* Own and continuously monitor regulatory compliance across US federal and state requirements (FDA food contact, CPSC, CA Prop 65, CA AB 1200, Colorado PFAS Act, and emerging state chemical legislation) and international standards (EU LFGB, EC No 1935/2004, REACH, RoHS, UK REACH post\-Brexit), always applying the most stringent applicable standard; lead regulatory change management as a distinct workstream, assessing impact and briefing stakeholders ahead of deadlines.
* Lead product component mapping and material disclosure, maintaining a complete picture of every material, coating, pigment, and component across Caraway's supply chain, including Declarations of Compliance, material safety data sheets, and test reports.
* Design and manage Caraway's testing strategy, selecting and managing third\-party labs (particularly in Asia, including NRTLs for small appliances), defining testing scope and frequency by product type and risk level, and sequencing testing within development timelines to avoid launch delays or costly late\-stage findings.
* Own claims substantiation: design and commission the clinical, laboratory, and comparative studies (for example migration testing, coating durability, comparative non\-stick performance) needed to support our non\-toxic, food\-safe, and sustainability claims. Partner with Marketing and Customer Research on which claims to make and how to communicate them, and ensure all claims are legally defensible and compliant with FTC guidelines and retailer requirements (Target, Crate \& Barrel, Bloomingdale's, etc.), including CA AB 1200 disclosure obligations.
* Conduct supply chain compliance diligence, including BSCI and Sedex (SMETA) social compliance audits and material certifications (OEKO\-TEX, FSC, GRS, GOTS); embed Caraway's material and safety standards directly into manufacturing quality plans in China so factory teams implement them consistently on the production line, not just on paper; manage supplier CAPA processes and produce performance reporting to inform sourcing decisions.

* Hands\-on experience with social compliance and supply chain auditing programs, including BSCI and Sedex/SMETA (2\- and 4\-pillar); familiarity with material certification schemes (OEKO\-TEX Standard 100, FSC, GRS, GOTS); skilled at managing CAPA processes and building supplier performance scorecards.
* Proven ability to develop and manage product testing strategies, including migration testing, heavy metals (lead, cadmium), PFAS/PFOA screening, sensory evaluation, and applicable electrical safety standards (UL, ETL, IEC 60335\) for small appliances.

* Ability to build and maintain product component maps and material traceability documentation across a multi\-supplier, multi\-category portfolio, including Declarations of Compliance, mill certificates, glaze and coating specifications, and batch\-level test records.

* Demonstrated experience building compliance programs or functions in an environment with limited existing infrastructure; entrepreneurial by nature, with the ability to prioritize and execute without relying on inherited playbooks.
* Ability to travel internationally to visit manufacturing partners and labs in Asia, up to 35 to 40% annually; experience working with facilities in China required, with additional familiarity across Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia) a plus.

**Position Title:** Marketing Manager

**Status:**Full Time

**FLSA:**Exempt

**Location:**Washington, DC (Hybrid)

  

**JOB SUMMARY \& KEY PRIORITIES**
---------------------------------


The **Marketing Manager** will translate Active Minds’ organizational and marketing strategies into integrated campaigns that drive measurable awareness, reach, participation, and engagement. Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing and Communications, this role will balance strategic planning with hands\-on implementation, helping move youth and young adults along the Active Minds Mobilization Journey while strengthening the organization’s brand and national reach.

  

The Marketing Manager will support the team by leading the strategy, planning, coordination, and execution of assigned brand and program marketing initiatives, including national campaigns, program launches, heritage month activations, and other organizational priorities. They will build campaign briefs and channel plans, coordinate implementation across email, CRM, web, social, PR, paid media, and other channels, and use audience and performance insights to improve results.

  

An agile, data\-informed, and audience\-centered marketer, the Marketing Manager will apply audience research, youth and young adult perspectives, and campaign performance data to strengthen targeting, messaging, and channel decisions. They will inform digital media buying strategies in collaboration with internal team members and partners, while leading the planning and execution of non\-digital media buys. They will also help improve Active Minds’ use of its CRM and marketing platforms to deliver more relevant, coordinated audience experiences.

**ABOUT ACTIVE MINDS**
----------------------


Active Minds is the nation’s leading nonprofit organization mobilizing youth and young adults to change the culture around mental health. Through our presence in more than 1,000 high schools, colleges, and communities, and with a wide\-reaching public audience, Active Minds is creating communities of support and saving lives. Founded in 2003 by Alison Malmon after the tragic suicide of her brother, Brian, Active Minds is dedicated to supporting a new generation in ending the silence, helping to make mental health as highly valued as physical health. We approach our work with a racial equity lens and are committed to the continued process of being and becoming a more antiracist and inclusive organization. Through our many programs, we are changing social norms and behaviors related to mental health across the country.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

**Integrated Marketing Strategy \& Execution**

* **Strategic Campaign Leadership:** Lead the development and implementation of integrated marketing strategies for assigned programs, campaigns, and organizational priorities. Translate organizational goals into clear campaign objectives, audience strategies, messaging, channel plans, implementation timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* **Brand \& Initiative Management:** Lead assigned brand campaigns, heritage month activations, program launches, and other brand initiatives. Coordinate the development of high\-impact content, merchandise, promotional materials, and collateral that support organizational goals and maintain brand consistency.
* **Audience Insights \& Analytics:** Apply audience research, youth and young adult perspectives, organizational knowledge, and performance data to inform personas, targeting, messaging, and campaign decisions. Monitor performance throughout campaigns and recommend adjustments to improve results.
* **Cross\-Functional Campaign Management:** Work collaboratively across departments and internal marketing teams to lead campaigns from brief through launch, optimization, and post\-campaign analysis. Build timelines, coordinate deliverables and approvals, manage dependencies, identify risks, and ensure work is implemented across relevant channels.
* **Paid Media Planning:** Use audience insights and campaign goals to inform digital media strategies and recommendations. Lead non\-digital media buying projects from planning and vendor coordination through placement, tracking, and performance assessment. Prior experience with non\-digital media buying is preferred, but candidates with relevant transferable experience and the ability to learn this work will be considered..
* **Customer Journey \& Strategic Plan Tracking:** Map and monitor audience experiences across the Active Minds Mobilization Journey, identifying opportunities to strengthen conversion, participation, and continued engagement. Maintain implementation plans and progress reporting for assigned priorities within the MarComm strategic plan.
* **Cross\-Functional \& External Representation:** Represent MarComm in cross\-functional meetings and with external partners as assigned. Build trusted relationships across teams, clarify marketing needs and responsibilities, and help identify integrated solutions to organizational challenges.
* **Merchandise \& E\-commerce Strategy:** Support strategy and growth plan for Active Minds' e\-commerce platform and branded merchandise, leveraging it to increase brand visibility, drive sustainable revenue, and deepen community engagement.
* **CRM and Lifecycle Marketing:** Develop and execute audience segmentation, email journeys, campaign workflows, and lifecycle communications that move audiences from awareness to participation and continued engagement. Manage campaign implementation within Active Minds’ CRM and marketing platforms, including audience lists, testing, tracking, and reporting.
* **Marketing Operations and Measurement**: Help maintain consistent campaign practices, including integrated marketing calendars, project workflows, campaign naming conventions, UTMs, testing plans, dashboards, and post\-campaign reporting. Document insights and apply lessons learned to future campaigns.

 **Planning, Reporting and Team Support**

* Represent MarComm in cross\-functional meetings and with external partners as assigned.
* Build trusted relationships across teams, clarify marketing needs and responsibilities, and help identify integrated solutions to organizational challenges.
* Lead the communication of MarComm performance updates and compile reporting for biweekly Staff Notes and Board Reports
* Lead cross\-functional project meetings with agendas and action items
* Monitor progress against assigned priorities within the MarComm strategic plan, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and decisions needed.
* Provide thought partnership to MarComm team members

 **Team Management**

* May manage direct reports and support recruiting and hiring.
* Participate in monthly MarComm leads meeting to discuss, set, and act on priorities

 **Additional Responsibilities**

* Serve as a MarComm representative in meetings and events when needed
* Other duties as assigned.


**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* Curious strategic thinker with a growth mindset
* Proactive and resourceful collaborator who can move complex work forward, build trust across teams, and balance ambitious thinking with thoughtful execution.
* Passion for changing the culture around mental health nationwide.
* Belief that equity and social justice are important and driven to hear, reflect, and act on this belief.
* Energized by audience insights, marketing technology, experimentation, and performance data, and able to translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate new concepts and visions for programs or content that will measurably change the culture around mental health.
* Exemplary relationship building and customer service skills.
* Able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, stakeholders, and dependencies while maintaining attention to detail and adapting to changing priorities.

 **You need to have:**

* Five or more years of experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns, preferably within a nonprofit, mission\-driven, youth\-focused, or multi\-program organization.
* Demonstrated ability to translate organizational goals into campaign strategies, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience using a CRM or marketing automation platform for audience segmentation, campaign execution, lifecycle communications, and reporting.
* Experience managing complex, cross\-functional campaigns through a project management platform.
* Working knowledge of email marketing, websites and landing pages, analytics, UTMs, testing, and campaign performance reporting.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, stakeholders, and dependencies simultaneously.
* Experience using audience insights and performance data to improve marketing decisions.
* Experience with Salesforce, ClickUp, Google Analytics 4, and relevant email marketing or content management platforms.
* Strong writing, presentation, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Commitment to centering youth and young adult perspectives and advancing equity and inclusion.

 **Nice to have:**

* Experience supervising employees, interns, contractors, agencies, or vendors.
* Experience with traditional media planning or buying.
* Experience with merchandise, e\-commerce, or consumer products.
* Experience marketing programs to youth and young adults.
* Experience working in mental health, education, advocacy, or another mission\-driven field.

  

**OUR CULTURE**
---------------


Active Minds is a place where every employee matters. We value diverse perspectives, radical authenticity, and a community\-driven approach. We dream big, offering flexibility to staff while we work to achieve our mission. As such, we are proud to offer competitive salaries and benefits and an environment that is friendly to remote working and life/work balance.

  

Active Minds is an equal\-opportunity employer that works to advance racial equity and social justice in an increasingly multicultural and globally connected world. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background, intersectional identities, and lived experiences. We make a particular effort to recruit people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, and people with other marginalized identities. Active Minds encourages all to apply for our open positions as we depend on a diverse staff to carry out our mission.

  

**COMPENSATION**
----------------


This position offers an initial salary range of $68,250–$77,700 along with robust benefits. The starting pay for this position is equal to others at the same level throughout the organization. Candidates whose experience meets both the minimum and preferred qualifications may be considered for a starting salary that exceeds the current amount. The role sits within Active Minds Level 3 salary band, and as such, has the potential to grow to $96,600 over time. FLSA Status: Exempt.


Active Minds has an industry\-leading and competitive benefits package that includes Health, Vision and Dental Insurance, Paid Vacation and Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Company Wide Mental Health Days, 401(k) Matching, HSA and FSA Options, Life Insurance, Short Term and Long Term Disability, Fully Paid Parental Leave, Wellness Reimbursement Program, and Professional Development Stipends.


Active Minds recruits, hires, trains, compensates, and promotes our staff regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

 **TO APPLY**  

  

***The preferred application deadline is Monday, September 28, 2026\.*** This search is being supported by NRG Consulting Group. Please reach out to jobs@nrgconsultinggroup.org with any questions.  

**ACTIVE MINDS RECRUITING PROTOCOLS**
-------------------------------------

* Active Minds will never ask an applicant to send – and Active Minds will never send an applicant \- a check or any payment or item of value (such as a gift card) in connection with the interview process or job onboarding process.
* Active Minds will never ask for personal information about an applicant (such as their Social Security number or banking information) until the job onboarding process;
